digest.component_or_area: mutation testing gate and behavioral-test shard enforcement
propositions: Mutation shard enforcement modes (advisory, ratchet, strict) with per-shard configuration in a single source-of-truth manifest require promotion through evidence-based gates rather than accepting all current survivors or blocking unrelated work.

The mutation gate must distinguish between AST-identical unchanged functions (preserving legacy outcomes) and newly added/edited functions (requiring killed mutants or individually reviewed equivalent fingerprints) to prevent regression while enabling iterative remediation.

Fresh isolated base/head archives with no persisted mutation verdict cache, pinned mutmut 3.7.0, per-shard 30-minute job limits, and deterministic timeout policies (constant 1.0 + multiplier 15.0) eliminate false negatives from stale cache and configuration drift.

Selector-derived per-shard matrix jobs with Gerrit patchset pinning, vote.needs integration, weekly/manual all-shard coverage, and always-published structured evidence (survivor diffs, fingerprints, and summary) enable deterministic promotion and operator audit.

Documentation contract test validates phased policy, promotion evidence requirements, manifest authority, and removal of legacy score tables to enforce CI intent and prevent regression into stale baselines.
